rec.name: PDP Image Info Buttons (Info Bar Overlay with Tooltip)
rec.status: Built — launched (v1.0 delivered and tested; v1.1 ideas collected)

what.text: A slim info bar placed on each product gallery image, either overlaid at the bottom of the image or underneath it. It shows a short benefit or USP headline (e.g. 'High-quality 925 sterling silver', 'With important cofactors', 'Includes free Mjuck insert worth up to €79'). An (i) icon at the right edge reveals a longer explanatory text in a tooltip bubble on hover. The text is maintained per product and per image. If no title is maintained for an image, the whole bar is hidden. The tooltip appears only if a detail text exists.

why.text: Short USPs sit directly on the product image, where attention is highest, so key benefits are seen without scrolling to the description. The optional (i) tooltip gives details on demand, which keeps the image clean while answering objections (material, ingredients, bonus value) at the moment of consideration. This supports perceived value and reduces uncertainty. Custom colors let the bar match the brand and stay unobtrusive.

how.text: Original build is a theme-code integration: (1) Create the snippet info-buttons.liquid. It takes the image loop index and reads title and text from a product metafield list (later converted to a metaobject so merchants only enter text instead of editing JSON). It renders the bar only if the title is not blank, and the (i) icon and tooltip only if the text is not blank. CSS positions the bar absolutely at the bottom center of the media item. The tooltip is a white bubble with an arrow that fades in on icon hover. (2) Add a 'Info buttons' settings block to the product section schema, with colors, width and position. (3) Render the snippet inside each product media item in product-media.liquid, passing forloop.index. The 'under image' option sets the bar bottom to 0 and adds bottom padding to the media item. Instructions must be theme-independent, since not every theme has main-product.liquid, and written so non-experts can follow them.

items: Info bar background color (default #ffffff; clearing the hex gives a transparent bar)
Info button background / fill color (default transparent; the schema label is mislabeled as a duplicate 'Info bar text color')
Info bar width, 20–100% (default 80%), to make it as wide as or narrower than the image
Info bar position: Inside image / Under image
Per-product content (metaobject or metafield): title and tooltip text per image; empty title hides the bar
Style variations (requested by the PL team; the code shows only color variations)
v1.1 ideas: adjustable bar height, icon size, text alignment (left / centered)

dependencies.text: Needs a product metafield (standard.info_buttons) with a list of title/text entries, later replaced by a metaobject for easier editing. Requires editing theme files: new snippet info-buttons.liquid, schema in the main product section, and a render call in the product-media snippet inside the media item loop. Built and tested on a Dawn-like theme (sectionfy.io). The CSS selector .product__media-item may need adjusting for other themes. The metafield definition must exist before content can be edited, and Shopify can take time to reflect metafield changes. Non-devs cannot install it without the instructions.

items: Tooltip hover/tap rate on the (i) icon
Scroll depth and engagement with the product gallery
Mobile vs desktop conversion difference (tooltip uses hover; mobile behavior should be verified)
